jobs.title: Find a job
jobs.text: The «Jobs» tab shows all vacancies. Filter by area, salary and schedule, and apply in one tap.

workers.title: Find workers
workers.text: The «Workers» tab shows ready candidates. Each one displays a match percentage for your vacancy.

post.title: AI writes your job post
post.text: The «Post» tab — describe it in your own words. AI organizes it into sections and creates polished text and a promo image.

chat.title: Chat and notifications
chat.text: Applications, offers and replies are in «Chat» and 🔔. Important messages also arrive on Telegram.

quick.title: What would you like to do?

cross.worker_desc: You can post a vacancy too — AI will write it in 1 minute
cross.employer_desc: One account lets you search for both jobs and workers
